text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down over the past day despite elevated greed sentiment, suggesting traders are taking modest profits after recent strength rather than showing fresh conviction. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady at 58.7% indicates the market is neither rotating aggressively toward alts nor consolidating around BTC alone. The 90 billion in 24-hour volume is solid but not exceptional, consistent with a market in equilibrium—greed-driven but lacking urgency to push prices higher.
